title: GET /api/products response — frozen baseline contract
description: A frozen snapshot of the real backend/src/routes/products.routes.js GET / response shape. This file represents what a previously-shipped API consumer was built against. additionalProperties is intentionally left as the schema default (true) at every level, because adding a NEW field is a non-breaking, additive change — only a REMOVED required field or a CHANGED type is a breaking change.
